newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA is target of criminal probe - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA is target of criminal probe - WSJ.

text.p: Federal prosecutors have declared Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp a target of the criminal investigation into whether the company defrauded the federal government, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
The paper said in its electronic edition that the designation means the government believes it has sufficient evidence to indict not only Columbia executives, but the company itself.
Columbia officials told the paper the company did not receive formal notification that is a target in the criminal investigation.

The paper also said prosecutors in the case will ask the judge who presides over the arraignment of three Columbia officials next week to determine whether Columbia has been paying the three executives' legal bills.
The three have been indicted on charges of defrauding U.S. Medicare and military-health programmes by inflating reimbursement requests.
Columbia's business practices have been the focus of a government investigation.
